kind: G0 functional probe (implementation plan 2.1 / 2.), n=1 per question; not gate data
run: docker run --rm --network none --cpus 2 --memory 1g (probe and seed child process in one container)
history: v1 shared one event loop between the seed and the probe (native calls starved the seed); v2 runs the seed in a child process with an accurate token bucket and uTP refusal. Earlier v2 runs used before these fixes are not evidence.

D_call_cost_us_4000_pieces.note: Wall-clock on the probe container; order of magnitude only, not a gate metric.

stable_across_runs: set_piece_deadline on a priority-0 piece reports priority 7; a finished deadline piece reports priority 1.

reset_piece_deadline leaves an unfinished piece at priority 1, not 0: in the product, deadline pieces dropped from the window (e.g. after a seek) stay wanted at priority 1 until the stream ends. SP01 must restore the intended priority explicitly.

Native per-call cost is tens of microseconds for have_piece / status(query_pieces) / get_piece_priorities / prioritize_pieces and below 1 us for set/reset_piece_deadline: a larger window must read the piece bitfield once per update instead of one have_piece call per piece.
The product calls the deprecated piece_priorities() (DeprecationWarning in 2.1.1).
Background priority 1 delays the deadline pieces (C): SP01 candidate C3 is suspect before measurement.
not_stable_or_artefact: A (deadline after idle peers connected): downloaded in one run, not within 15 s in another; connections with nothing wanted may be closed as redundant. Scenario 'replay of an idle relay torrent' is worth an H1 run.
F/G absolute rates are harness-bound (single container, 2 CPUs); only relative hints, not results.
repeated_hint_not_result: G: with the rest at priority 0, a 64-piece deadline window (far deadlines up to ~32 s) finished the first 64 pieces slower than a 4- or 16-piece window in both v2 runs (1.56-1.78 vs 2.4-2.7 MB/s). Far deadlines may not be requested early by the time-critical picker: SP01 must measure window size and deadline spacing, a larger window is not automatically faster.
